summary: Qinni Liu is a scholar in Buddhist studies who earned a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University (attested 2009). The MA was supervised by Kirill Jurievitch Solonin, with D.-D. Huang and Cheng-I Weng on the committee.
Qiwen Xiao specializes in Buddhist studies and completed a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University (attested 2013) under the supervision of Yongdong Shi.

R. Balasubramanian (1929–2017) worked in philosophy and Indology. He studied under traditional teacher Varahur Kalyanasundara Sastri (attested 1988) and served as Director at the University of Madras (~1980–1990).

R. Gordon Wasson (1898–1986) worked in Indology and religious studies. Educated at Columbia and LSE, his career spanned journalism and banking, including the American Expeditionary Forces, New York Herald Tribune, Guaranty Trust Company, and J.P. Morgan & Co. (1934–1963).
R. N. Gadre, an Indologist, served as Professor of Sanskrit at Sir Parashurambhau College and Savitribai Phule Pune University (both attested 1959).
R. P. Paranjpye (1876–1966) studied under Vaman Shivram Apte and served as Vice-Chancellor of Savitribai Phule Pune University (attested 1959).

R. Thangaswami Sarma (1924–2000) was an Indology and philosophy scholar educated at Annamalai University and The Madras Sanskrit College. He held posts at Presidency College, Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, ICPR, and Adyar Library and Research Centre (1994–2000).

R. Venkatraman specializes in history, archaeology, and religious studies. He earned a PhD from Madurai Kamaraj University (1975–1980) under N. Subrahmanian and N. Jagadeesan, later serving there as Reader (attested 1990).
Rachael Wiseman is a philosopher who studied at the University of York and held a post at the University of Liverpool around 2014.

Rachel H. Pang, a scholar of Tibetology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies, earned her PhD at the University of Virginia. She served as Lester D. Coltrane III Assistant Professor of Religious Studies at Davidson College (attested 2019).

Rachelle M. Scott works in Buddhist and religious studies. She earned her doctorate at Northwestern University under George D. Bond and Robert Launay, and held a post at the University of Tennessee (attested 2009–2017).

Radhika Herzberger (born 1938) works in Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Toronto under Bimal Krishna Matilal (~1976–1982) and became Director of Studies at Rishi Valley School (~1982).

Rafal Stepien is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He completed his PhD at Columbia University under Chun-fang Yu and Bernard Faure, and held positions at Wadham College (2012–2013) and Harvard University (attested 2015).

Rafał Jan Felbur specializes in Buddhist studies and sinology. He pursued PhD studies at Stanford University (attested 2015) under Paul Harrison, also studying under John R. McRae and Luis Oscar Gómez.

Raffaele Torella (born 1950) is an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Raniero Gnoli (~1968–1974). He held posts at Sapienza University of Rome (attested 2004–2022) and the University of Naples "L'Orientale" (attested 2022).
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar of sinology and Buddhist studies who completed a PhD at Princeton University in 1981 under the supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan studied engineering at IIT Madras and trained under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar. He has taught at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and served as visiting faculty at IIM Ahmedabad (attested 2010).

Raghu Vira (1902–1963) was a scholar in Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Tibetology. He studied at the University of the Punjab (~1920–1924) and Leiden University (~1928–1930), and taught Lokesh Chandra.

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) worked in Indology and philosophy. He was principal at Sir Parashurambhau College and served as Professor and Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.
Raghunath Giri, a scholar of Indology and philosophy who taught Atsushi Uno, studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya and served as department head at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.
